value_updates.access_distribution: The client sends the landing-page link to selected customers.
value_updates.recipient_view_behavior: Recipients can view the landing page through the sent link.
value_updates.viewing_audience: Only specific customers to whom the client sends the link should be able to view the landing page.

verdicts.decision_note: The link-mediated viewing behavior is implementation-relevant, but the updates must preserve the client's explicit restriction to selected recipients.
The client adds a concrete acceptance condition requiring a complete, working landing page accessible through a customer-facing link without further work.
This is the first target-specific claim that the final landing page was deployed at an available Netlify link; it does not independently verify runtime access.
